elements_selected.content: Extend src/scanner.rs to extract SPL content from fenced code blocks tagged `spl` or `spindle`. During the existing Markdown scan pass (which already tracks code block boundaries via pulldown-cmark), identify spl-tagged blocks and capture their content with provenance. Produce SplBlock structs with source_file, source_page, start_line, end_line, content. Rules: 1) Both backtick and tilde fences accepted, 2) Multiple blocks per file concatenated in document order, 3) Blocks inside HTML comments ignored (consistent with SPEC-001 §3.3), 4) Blocks inside nested fences ignored. Also detect standalone .spl files during the file walk (by extension) and create SplBlocks for them (start_line=1, content=entire file). Extend ParsedFile to include spl_blocks: Vec<SplBlock>. Per SPEC-005 §5.4 extraction algorithm.
